changelog:
# DriveFight v0.16.2

- Finer controller steering and aim with one deadzone, plus predictable handoff between mouse, Q/E and right-stick aiming.
- Mouse aiming respects car height, and right-mouse camera orbit responds consistently across frame rates.
- Reverse driving no longer builds drift charge; stopping clears stale drift feedback while forward drift rewards remain.
- Bots and flamethrowers can fire past pickup volumes while still respecting solid cover.
- Soccer turf gains close-up grass detail, subtler wear and less obvious texture tiling.
- Refined car paint, tapered projectile trails and clearer damage smoke.
- Opaque death spheres are replaced by an ember burst and rising mushroom-shaped smoke.

Protocol 8. Includes the v0.16.1 ground-contact improvements. Mac and Windows clients and the Tower server ship together. Arena Battle and Soccer support private online matches; Training Survival and Capture the Flag remain offline.
